ToolboxOptions.AuthorName: Ethan Meyers, Vijay Iyer, Dylan Muir, Eivind Hennestad, Xinzhu Fang, Shubo Chakrabarti, Steve Van Hooser, et al.
ToolboxOptions.Summary: Access and use the public neural recording datasets from the Allen Brain Observatory
ToolboxOptions.Description: A MATLAB toolbox for accessing and using the public neural recording datasets from the Allen Brain Observatory: Visual Coding (Neuropixels and 2-photon calcium imaging) and Visual Behavior (Neuropixels and 2-photon calcium imaging).
